title: 为什么会打嗝
subtitle: 身体里的小意外
character: wearing an orange hoodie, grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, friendly flat cartoon art with clean rounded outlines and flat warm colours, coral, cream and soft blue, simple shapes, gentle and reassuring

pages.zh:
我喝汽水喝得太急，
忽然——
嗝！
身体自己抖了一下，
嘴里发出一个声音。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a table holding a glass, his shoulders jumping with a hiccup, a surprised look on his face.

pages.zh:
打嗝的时候，
动的不是嘴巴，
是胸腔下面的一块肌肉。
它叫「膈肌」，
是一块平平的、像伞一样的肉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple cross-section of a chest on a cream background with a flat dome-shaped muscle drawn across the middle, below the lungs. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
平时呼吸，
它慢慢往下拉，
空气就吸进来；
慢慢往上顶，
空气就呼出去。一上一下，很有节奏。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two chest cross-sections side by side on a cream background: in the left one the dome muscle is pulled down and the lungs are large; in the right one the dome is pushed up and the lungs are small. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可有时候，
它会突然抽一下。
这一下没打招呼，
一大口空气被猛地吸进来，
速度很快。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one chest cross-section on a cream background with the dome muscle drawn sharply pulled down and one bold arrow showing air rushing in fast. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
就在这时候，
喉咙上面的声门
啪地关上了。
空气撞在关着的门上——
嗝！声音就是这么来的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple throat cross-section on a cream background with a small flap closed across it and one arrow of air hitting the closed flap. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
什么会让膈肌抽一下呢？
吃太快、喝太急、
吃得太饱、
喝汽水、
或者忽然大笑、忽然受凉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: five small symbols in a row on a cream background: a fork with food, a fizzy drink, a full stomach shape, a laughing mouth and a snowflake. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
小婴儿打嗝更多。
因为他们的膈肌还没长好，
吃奶的时候
又容易吸进空气。
这很正常，不是生病。
pages.scene: One baby lying on a soft blanket on a cream background with a small milk bottle beside it, calm and content. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大多数打嗝，
过几分钟就自己停了。
不用紧张，
也不用怕，
它只是身体的一个小意外。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple clock face on a cream background with a short arc marked on it showing only a few minutes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
想让它快点停，
可以慢慢喝几口温水，
或者屏住呼吸数到十，
让身体里的
二氧化碳多一点。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one glass of warm water on a cream background beside one hand showing ten fingers, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
也可以慢慢深呼吸，
吸气的时候数到四，
吐气的时候数到六。
膈肌慢下来，
抽动就容易停。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple wave line on a cream background with a short rising part and a longer falling part, repeated twice. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
要是打嗝很久都不停，
超过两天，
那就要告诉大人，
去看看医生。
不过这种情况很少见。
pages.scene: One friendly grown-up doctor in a white coat on a cream background, drawn plainly, standing beside a chair. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我慢慢喝了几口温水，
又深深地吸了一口气。
数到十的时候，
嗝就没有了。
下次喝汽水，我不喝那么急了。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at the table holding a glass of water with both hands, taking a slow sip, calm and relieved.
